aiResearchSummary.text: Astek Diagnostics is researching a method and device for detecting presence, concentration, and antibiotic resistance of bacteria in urine. The abstract describes an automated system that in about one hour determines bacterial load and resistance to a panel of antibiotics, guiding treatment decisions. It also mentions an automated assay to detect mammalian cell viability via reduction reactions. Together, these efforts target rapid antimicrobial susceptibility testing and viability assays.
